definition: Complete finite review of every frozen scientific document, all six axes, every material original obligation and consequential source family at research-proposal level; not exhaustive proof of all library behavior or future software.

axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.assessment: All original obligations and negative constraints retained; local editing, comments/roles, approval and visible cached release are explicit.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.assessment: Consequential Loro and alternative facts checked with versions, package distinctions, defaults and exceptions; native source/callers/selected tests inspected.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.assessment: Native move, stable cursor, mergeable-child identity, causal pending ranges, writer identity and shallow-history limits are useful discoveries; Rust and server/web alternatives remain plausible.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.assessment: All12 material plan rows correct. C-01/C-02 valid and addressed; C-03 appropriately clarifies an already provisional hypothesis. No false rejection found.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.assessment: Supported discovery/draft meanings, conditions, alternatives, unknowns and validation status survive. Deletion-race/durable-boundary additions improve specificity without weakening scope.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.assessment: Proposed checks have relevant failure triggers/oracles; no application execution or deployment claimed. Artifact/hash checks are not presented as software correctness.

obligations.assessment: Keep fully local editing; app-owned durable commit before saved feedback.
Separate cue entities/order; explicit move intent and human review of incompatible placement.

obligations.obligation: Collaborative cue text and timing notes
obligations.assessment: Granular collaborative text plus semantic conflict review; timing is independently editable.
Independent fields merge; competing values remain intelligible and resolvable.

obligations.obligation: Cue/comment stable references and deleted anchors
obligations.assessment: Comments use cue IDs, survive reorder, and stay visibly anchored to tombstones after deletion.
Issue-level candidates, explicit decisions, retained context and late-candidate review.
Use causal revision identity rather than device clocks; inspect history/frontier/head semantics.
Publish a new immutable selected-state artifact with approval identity; later edits cannot replace it.

obligations.obligation: Visible version and disconnected stage viewing
obligations.assessment: Named published version, offline cache, deliberate refresh/switch; no silent draft replacement.
Application persistence/outbox/ack boundary; core transport conditions and crash cases.
Structured stable-reference round trip; staff visibility/format remain owner decisions.
Compare researched mechanisms and relevant release/issue/fix context without assuming adoption.
No always-online editor, enterprise account, new chat product, or demanded deployment.
Counts, crew authority, comment scope, export visibility, relay/retention remain explicit unknowns.
Every material plan choice is retained, changed or rejected with reason; timestamp backup never treated as tested.

out_of_scope_or_unavailable.area: Future app execution/deployment, UI adapter, crash correctness and performance
out_of_scope_or_unavailable.reason: Proposed validation, not required executed deliverable.

out_of_scope_or_unavailable.area: Actual cue counts, crew authority, export visibility, relay/retention decisions
out_of_scope_or_unavailable.reason: User-specific unknowns explicitly permitted and retained.

out_of_scope_or_unavailable.area: Native actual task/session linkage, provider activity, context occupancy, billing
out_of_scope_or_unavailable.reason: Unavailable independent telemetry; capture custody is weaker evidence.
